messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: `LB-TargetGroup-apse1` marked UNHEALTHY (TLS handshake failures) — ~40% 5xx on edge for ap-southeast-1. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. PD Incident: RDW-PD-8734.

pagerduty-bot: Incident routed to on-call rotation: maya -> escalation policy 2. Auto-notify 60s.

maya: ackd. I'm on it. pulling metrics now — looks like target health toggling across two target groups (tg-lm-1 and tg-lm-2).

sophie_sre: adding context: we've seen similar flaps when a kernel update left TLS libs mismatched on a small batch of hosts. low confidence. checking recent deploys: `deploy-bot` shows a config push to tg-lm-2 at 2024-11-25T02:12Z.

jordan_eng: I can run a quick sim curl to a few healthy/failed backends. sharing results:```curl -v https://edge-apse-redwood.example/v1/healthcheck -H "Host: ai.redwood"```
failed host: TLS handshake alert (no shared cipher).

maya: paging ops playbook: 1) remove tg-lm-2 from ALB, 2) shift traffic to tg-lm-1, 3) run `aws elbv2 describe-target-health` -> confirm. Do we want canonical rollback or DNS weight shift?

sophie_sre: prefer ALB target deregistration first (fast) while we validate TLS stack on tg-lm-2. Route53 changes take TTL to propagate, riskier.

diego_sre: agreed. I'll run the deregister on a canary set (2 hosts) and watch ingress.

lina_cs: customers reporting increased errors: Customer AcmeCorp seeing 30% failure for embeddings calls since 02:17Z. Support ticket #64321 opened. Please call out in comms if we expect >30m impact.

ryan_oncall: escalated to P1. Noting SLO impact: 99.9% target for v1 generate; currently ~99.2% for ap-southeast-1. I'll loop in growth/comm.

jordan_eng: running command: ```aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:tg-lm-2 --targets Id=i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g --region ap-southeast-1``` — started at 4159871240.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: maya acknowledged and assigned. 2h default incident lead: maya.

maya: initial traffic shift executed. Observability: error rate for /v1/generate dropped from 41% -> 6% within 40s of deregistration. Latency stable. Starting health checks on tg-lm-2 hosts.

sophie_sre: logs from failing hosts show OpenSSL alerts: "unsupported protocol" and cipher mismatch with upstream edge TLS policy. Looks like a config drift that landed in last config push.

diego_sre: taking tg-lm-2 hosts out of autoscaling group temporarily and rolling patch to restore TLS configuration. will coordinate with infra for a controlled replace.

lina_cs: communicated to AcmeCorp: "We saw elevated errors in ap-southeast-1 starting ~02:16Z. We shifted traffic and are repairing affected hosts. We expect full service restoration in ~15-30 minutes. Ticket #64321." (reacted :thumbsup:).

ryan_oncall: good. Confirming customer-impacted list and SLA windows. Marking incident P1 -> customer-facing. I'll open a short status page update.

deploy-bot: detected rollback candidate: previous config hash `h12f9` available for tg-lm-2. Notifying: `--rollback` ready.

maya: decision: do NOT rollback cluster-wide. We will patch the TLS config on affected hosts and then re-register. Rollback could destabilize other AZs. Proceeding with patch + validation.

jordan_eng: patch applied to host i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g: OpenSSL libs updated, TLS cipher list set to policy `redwood-v2`. Running healthcheck: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://host-ip:8443/health` -> `200`.

maya: re-registering patched hosts into tg-lm-2 now. Command: ```aws elbv2 register-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:tg-lm-2 --targets Id=i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g --region ap-southeast-1```

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: target re-registration started at 4159871405. Monitoring for 5m stabilization window.

sophie_sre: after re-registration, observed aggregate error rate back to baseline <1% in ap-southeast-1. TLS handshakes normal.

lina_cs: updated AcmeCorp: "Errors resolved; all calls nominal. Please re-open ticket if you still see issues."

ryan_oncall: moving to mitigation -> monitoring. We'll keep PD incident open for a postmortem. Assigning action items: 1) full root-cause analysis (sophie/diego), 2) runbook gap: add kernel/TLS ver mismatch checks (jordan), 3) customer comms follow-up (lina).

maya: incident status: mitigated at 4159871482. Closing active paging. Please file postmortem template: https://runbooks.redwood/pm/postmortem-template and tag with RDW-PD-8734.

diego_sre: logging timeline and will include config diff for tg-lm-2 change set.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident marked RESOLVED by maya at 4159871542.

maya: thanks all — great coordination. Follow-up sync in SRE channel in 2h to review RCA. (reacted :heart:).
